reasons: Top of both critic passes (6.74, then 6.45): its own geometry (a fused glass bowl with splash spires thrown round the rim), its own effect (charge crawling over the glass), the zone's violet accent, and the round's best photograph (seed 1, the frozen splash).

More variety across seeds (one round bowl each time): off-centre strikes, double strikes, a bowl broken by a dune.
Keep the giant-bones prop off its pad (quiet pad).
notes: Runners-up: B (colossus hand, 5.8) reads as a hand from above but its fingers are violet towers up close; A (buried caravan, 5.63) has the best props but the dune is stacked blocks.
